name: Ukifune Ryoutarou
source:
A mad scientist from the Tenkai District's Special Technical Division who developed the cyborg technology used on Niimi. 

Unlike Kadosaki, who thinks of Niimi as a mere tool in cracking the case, he interacts with him as he would with any normal person. 

Thought of as an outcast by most of his co-workers.

Part of Tenkai District Special Police

[Modified from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3595800/ROAD59_A_Yakuzas_Last_Stand/]Steam page[/url]]
